requirements.title: LBOUND argument restrictions
requirements.definition: ARRAY shall be assumed-rank or an array, shall not be an unallocated allocatable or disassociated pointer, DIM shall be an integer scalar in the range one through the rank of ARRAY with a corresponding actual argument that is not absent, disassociated, or unallocated, and KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

pending.LBOUND-ARRAY-assumed-rank-or-array: Positive control calls LBOUND on an explicit-shape array and inside an assumed-rank wrapper with a rank-one actual; source-control mutation uses a scalar non-assumed-rank actual and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.LBOUND-ARRAY-allocated-or-associated: Positive control allocates an allocatable array with lower bound -2 and associates a pointer with a target before calling LBOUND; source-control mutations leave each unallocated or disassociated and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.LBOUND-DIM-integer-scalar-in-rank-range: Positive control calls LBOUND(A,DIM=1) and LBOUND(A,DIM=2) for a rank-two array with distinct lower bounds; source-control mutations use DIM=0, DIM=3, and rank-one DIM array and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.LBOUND-DIM-corresponding-actual-present-: Positive control passes present, associated, and allocated actuals through a wrapper before using DIM; source-control mutations pass an absent optional, disassociated pointer, and unallocated allocatable and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.LBOUND-KIND-scalar-integer-constant-expr: Positive control calls LBOUND(A,KIND=selected_int_kind(18)); 7.4.3.1 p2 requires at least one integer representation method with decimal exponent range >= 18, so selected_int_kind(18) is a valid kind. Assert result kind; source-control mutations use a nonconstant integer variable and a rank-one KIND expression and claim no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: LBOUND result characteristics
requirements.definition: The LBOUND result is integer; KIND selects the result kind or default integer is used, DIM presence gives a scalar result, and DIM absence gives a rank-one array of size equal to the rank of ARRAY.

pending.LBOUND-result-integer-kind-default-or-KI: Call LBOUND on a rank-two array without KIND and with KIND=selected_int_kind(18); 7.4.3.1 p2 requires at least one integer representation method with decimal exponent range >= 18, so selected_int_kind(18) is a valid kind. Assert result KIND equals default integer kind and the selected kind respectively, and mutate the KIND value in the expected expression.
pending.LBOUND-result-scalar-with-DIM: Call LBOUND(A,DIM=2) for a rank-two array with lower bounds -3 and 7; assign to a scalar initialized to -999 and assert the scalar receives 7.
pending.LBOUND-result-rank-one-size-rank-without: Call LBOUND(A) for a rank-two array with lower bounds -3 and 7; assert SIZE(result)==2, LBOUND(result,DIM=1)==1, and the two elements equal the scalar DIM inquiries.

requirements.title: LBOUND DIM-present result value
requirements.definition: With DIM present, a whole array with nonzero extent in dimension DIM or an assumed-size array of rank DIM yields that dimension lower bound; other DIM-present cases yield one.

pending.LBOUND-DIM-whole-nonzero-extent-lower-bo: Use a whole rank-two array declared A(-3:4,7:9); assert LBOUND(A,DIM=1)==-3 and LBOUND(A,DIM=2)==7, and mutate the actual to an array section.
pending.LBOUND-DIM-assumed-size-rank-DIM-lower-b: Pass an explicit-shape actual with lower bound 2 to an assumed-size dummy declared D(2:*); assert LBOUND(D,DIM=1)==2 and mutate the dummy declaration lower bound.
pending.LBOUND-DIM-otherwise-one: Use a non-whole section A(-3:4:2,7:9) and a zero-extent whole array companion; assert the DIM result is 1, paired with a nonzero whole-array assertion returning -3 to prevent a vacuous default-one oracle.

requirements.title: LBOUND DIM-absent vector result value
requirements.definition: With DIM absent, LBOUND(ARRAY) yields a vector whose element i equals LBOUND(ARRAY,i), and LBOUND(ARRAY,KIND=KIND) yields the same element values with the selected integer kind.

pending.LBOUND-vector-elements-match-DIM-inquiri: Use a rank-three array declared A(-3:4,7:9,0:2); assert LBOUND(A) has elements -3, 7, and 0 matching LBOUND(A,1), LBOUND(A,2), and LBOUND(A,3), plus SIZE(result)==3.
pending.LBOUND-vector-KIND-elements-match-select: Use the same rank-three array with KIND=selected_int_kind(18); 7.4.3.1 p2 requires at least one integer representation method with decimal exponent range >= 18, so selected_int_kind(18) is a valid kind. Assert KIND of every vector element equals the selected kind and values match the scalar KIND inquiries, then mutate the KIND argument to default.

accounting.rationale: Classifies LBOUND as an inquiry function.
Result Value paragraph is split into DIM-present and DIM-absent cases.
Case (i) exact scalar lower-bound result values.
Case (ii) exact vector lower-bound result values and KIND variant.
Note explains that rank-zero assumed-rank ARRAY cannot satisfy the DIM range; the range restriction is already registered under p3.
Examples paragraph is illustrative and duplicates p5 values for a rank-two explicit-shape array.
